create_CXXCompiler: create a CXXCompiler instance with a compiler path and optional flags for C++ compilation
compile_CXXCompiler: compile C++ source files to an object file using the CXXCompiler compile method
preprocess_CXXCompiler: preprocess C++ source files using the CXXCompiler preprocess method with custom flags
check_hasCompileFlag: check if the CXXCompiler supports a given compile flag using hasCompileFlag
dumpMacros_CXXCompiler: dump preprocessor macros defined by the compiler using the dumpMacros method
